integrity: The proof uses the normalization, including two rational places outside the displayed affine chart. Finite-field enumerations independently corroborate nine cases and are not substitutes for the general proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact counts are proved only for the first two finite extensions of the prime field and only for odd primes, n>=2. The full zeta function, further extension counts and historical priority are not certified.
title: First two point counts of prime-field maximal curves with trivial automorphism group
